dedup.scope: all 82 adopted bank rows plus 130 safe standing DEV rows, actual payloads

matrix.limit: single other value; midnight, noon, irregular readings untested

noun change alone; no distinct syntax claim

matrix.dimension: clock half versus elapsed and fraction
matrix.stable: meeting and numeral two for first contrast; duration and predicate for second
matrix.changed: first: 時/時間, PM and predicate; second: 半; third: noun and full construction
matrix.limit: first and third are near semantic controls, not minimal pairs; duration/fraction are negative guards

matrix.stable: recipient plus letter-writing or destination plus movement
matrix.changed: addition/removal of PM clock phrase and an occurrence of に
matrix.limit: cannot isolate role with a single substitution; paired sentences have different number of particles; role preservation required in C10/C12

locked_glossary_control.status: unresolved conditional blocker for future clock path
locked_glossary_control.evidence: No candidate clock implementation or concrete affected locked spans was supplied. Existing visible controls cannot prove locked-span safety.
locked_glossary_control.requirement: Before future implementation is accepted, independently identify real rule contact with locked/glossary spans and freeze relevant existing source/version/hash and portable control contents, or add independently authored portable controls in a separate approved data plan. If contact cannot be determined, mark unknown and do not claim coverage. No engine or lexicon edits authorized here.
